Malaysia's August Palm Oil Exports 1.29M Tons; Down 7.5%, MPOB Says

Malaysia's palm oil exports were down 7.5% on month at 1.29 million metric tons in August, the Malaysian Palm Oil Board said. 
The following are details of the August crop data and revised numbers for July, issued by MPOB: 
 
 
 
                              August         July          Change 
 
                                                         On Month 
 
Crude Palm Oil Output      1,817,499    1,792,596   Up      1.39% 
 
Palm Oil Exports           1,294,664    1,399,579   Dn       7.5% 
 
Palm Kernel Oil Exports      112,879       82,261   Up     37.22% 
 
Palm Oil Imports              49,524       49,566   Dn      0.09% 
 
Closing Stocks             2,824,488    2,627,898   Up      7.48% 
 
Crude Palm Oil             1,645,570    1,428,478   Up      15.2% 
 
Processed Palm Oil         1,178,918    1,199,420   Dn      1.71%
